en.hubeali: H 14937 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nowfaly, from Al-Sakuny, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws has said:
‘The Rasool Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘It is on you to travel at night, for the ground folds up at night’.
en.sarwar: A number of our companions, Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mahraan, from Sayf Bin Umeyra, from Basheer Al-Nabaal, from Humraan Bin Ayn who said: I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s.), ‘The people are saying the earth would fold up for us at night, how it would fold up?’ He (a.s.) said: ‘Like this’, then folded his (a.s.) cloth’.
